Self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue CONFIRMED and REFINED by /failure-autopsy 2026-06-08: two co-equal substrate gaps blocked adjudication, neither a bridge verdict. (1) PRIMARY -- navigation/survival-competence ceiling: the ARM_NAV_CONTROL positive control (spawn-in-reef, safety handed) returned G_H=0.0 (best hazard median ~36 vs the >=75 gate), so even with navigation-to-safety handed the agent cannot survive to the gate; per the script's own interpretation grid this routes to a navigation/competence substrate (scaffolded_sd054_onboarding P1/Stage-H survival leg, G1 0/3), NOT the bridge. (2) SECONDARY -- safety-half starvation: the safety detector credited 0/3 in every arm (relief half credited 2/3) because no trained threat-absence (MECH-303/304) predictor is wired into the escape-affordance-bridge safety half. Biology (Moscarello & LeDoux 2013) supports the mechanism class; this is a prerequisite/translation gap, not falsification. Do NOT weaken or validate SD-059/MECH-358. pending_retest_after_substrate: the SD-059/MECH-358 bridge retest (the 4-arm discriminative harness) is not informative until (1) the Stage-H navigation/survival-competence leg clears and (2) the safety-half threat-absence predictor is wired.
